jobs.title: AI Algorithmic Trader — Interview Today, Start Tomorrow!
jobs.description: AI Algorithmic Trader — MemeLabs, Inc. MemeLabs, Inc., a new startup division of MemeHouse LA, is hiring a systematic trader\-researcher to answer one question: can an AI learn to trade and improve itself, or does it only look like it is learning? You will design the strategies, the tests and the learning loop, on the world's largest DEXs. PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE ABLE TO START RIGHT AWAY **This role starts immediately.** The 45\- and 90\-day milestones run from your first day, so we can only consider candidates who are available to begin now. If you need a notice period or a later start date, please do not apply for this opening. Job details **Company** MemeLabs, Inc. (a startup division of MemeHouse LA) **Location** Beverly Hills, CA — in person and remote **Employment type** Full\-time, part\-time, W\-2 employee, or contract **Annual base salary** $120,000–$280,000 **Additional compensation** $5,000 performance\-based signing incentive, earned through two initial\-delivery milestones targeted for the first 90 days About us MemeHouse LA is launching a startup division, MemeLabs, Inc., where we build AI software that turns information into useful decisions and reliable workflows. Our focus is practical: secure AI deployments, connected systems, and applications that deliver measurable value. One of those applications is a systematic crypto trading program on the world's largest decentralized exchanges, across BTC, ETH, SOL and other major markets. An AI agent writes the backtests, bots, analysis and hourly market reads; it keeps a memory of what it tried and grades its own past predictions. So far the evidence says the AI is not yet learning, which is why this role exists: * A grid fitted to our in\-house AI market model's levels made **\+0\.43%/day** on the data it was tuned on and **0\.25%/day** on the next eight weeks. * The model's trade setups, tested on 1,497 trades, matched **random entries with the same stops and targets** almost to the basis point. We want someone who finds these results interesting, not discouraging. About the role As our AI Algorithmic Trader, you are the human in the loop between an AI that can build a trading bot in an hour and a market that punishes anything untested. You will design systematic strategies, build the evaluation that decides which ones are real, and engineer the loop that lets the AI learn from every result. This is a hands\-on role with ownership of meaningful deliverables. You will explain trade\-offs to non\-traders, document decisions, and help establish repeatable practices as the team grows. What you will do * **Design strategies:** Create systematic strategies with clear entry, exit, sizing and kill rules, and turn each into a testable hypothesis. * **Build the self\-improvement loop:** Decide what the AI remembers, how it grades its own calls, which changes it may make alone and which need a human; then prove with numbers whether it improves. * **Evaluate quality:** Build repeatable backtests with realistic fills, fees and slippage, walk\-forward splits, held\-out data, and a control for every result (random entries, random levels, a plain grid). * **Grade the AI market model:** Score its levels, setups and stated odds against simple baselines, and decide what, if anything, should drive bots. * **Run paper and live bots:** Move survivors to paper beside a control, then small live size; monitor, scale or retire them. * **Operate dependable systems:** Exchange\-side stops, software loss limits, a 90%\-of\-equity deploy cap, observability, versioning and rollback for every bot. * **Protect sensitive information:** Least\-privilege keys, secrets management, dry\-run\-first transfer scripts, and safeguards against prompt injection into the AI's tools. * **Improve the function:** Review code, document decisions in shared memory, and help mentor additional researchers as the team expands. Strategies you'll build and test **Family** Examples we run or have tested **Grid and ladder** Static and dynamic grids, re\-centring ping\-pong ladders, staggered take\-profits across many small orders **Mean reversion** Buying support and fading resistance from model\-picked levels, VWAP and range fades **Breakout and momentum** Close\-above / close\-below triggers, trailing take\-profits, trend\-gated entries **Accumulation** DCA and TWAP drips with price gates and breakeven stops **Signal\-driven** On\-chain flows, funding, open interest, liquidation clusters, stablecoin dominance, TradingView alerts **Regime switching** Hourly on/off switchboards, volatility and chop filters, scheduled\-event kill switches The interesting work is not any single strategy. It is building the process that tells the AI which ideas work, why, and what to try next. What we are looking for * **Systematic strategy experience:** 3\+ years designing, building and running your own systematic trading strategies, with live results you can walk us through, across several types (grid, mean reversio nels, secrets managers (1Password, Vault) How we work * **Evidence decides.** A result counts only out\-of\-sample, after fees, against a control. * **Tune on one period, judge on the next.** In\-sample winners are a hypothesis, not a strategy. * **Paper before live, small before large.** A new bot earns size over weeks, not hours. * **The AI builds; a human gates money.** Agents research, code and test. Launching, sizing and moving funds stay with people. * **Ask the exchange, don't model it.** Verify every stop is live and every fill is real. * **Write it down.** Every test, result and mistake goes into shared memory so it is never repeated. Your first 90 days * **First 30 days:** Learn the strategy library, bots, AI memory files and risk controls; audit which backtest and live numbers you trust and why; set up your environment and evaluation approach. * **Target by day 45 (milestone one):** A shared test harness with controls built in (random entries, random levels, plain grid), plus a scorecard that tracks whether the AI's ideas and market calls are improving, with reproducible setup and first results. * **Target by day 90 (milestone two):** At least one strategy that beats its control on unseen data and in paper trading, running live at small size with monitoring, kill switches and a launch\-and\-rollback runbook, and a written first answer on whether the AI is improving. Compensation and $5,000 signing incentive The annual base salary range is $120,000–$280,000\. The starting offer will reflect the responsibilities of the position, demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and internal pay equity; the $5,000 incentive is separate from base salary. We offer a $5,000 gross performance\-based signing incentive, structured as a new\-hire milestone bonus rather than an upfront payment: * **Milestone one: $2,500\.** Earned on completion of the agreed test harness, AI scorecard and initial results, targeted for day 45\. * **Milestone two: $2,500\.** Earned on completion of the agreed validated strategy, live monitoring, runbook and written AI\-improvement assessment, targeted for day 90\. Written milestone requirements and objective acceptance criteria will be provided before employment begins. Each installment is earned when its criteria are satisfied and will be paid on the next regular payday, or earlier if required by applicable law, less required tax withholdings. The 45\- and 90\-day dates are delivery targets, not minimum\-service or automatic\-forfeiture dates. Once earned, an installment is not conditioned on continued employment through its payment date and does not have to be repaid if employment later ends. Milestones measure delivery of the agreed work, not trading profit. Benefits * **Health coverage:** Employer\-sponsored health insurance, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Retirement benefits:** 401(k) participation, subject to plan eligibility and terms. * **Time off:** Unlimited paid time off under the company's written policy, plus applicable paid sick leave and other legally protected leave. Why join us? You will own a live experiment in whether AI can learn to trade, and shape how it is built and run. We value clear thinking, candid communication, responsible handling of capital and data, and strategies that hold up beyond the backtest. Equal opportunity and accommodations MemeLabs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law and provide reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment. How to apply Submit your resume, a GitHub profile or portfolio if available, and one page on a systematic strategy you built and later killed: what it was, what the backtest said, and what made you stop it. Applications to: saturntrader@abtrust.ai. Please do not submit confidential information or proprietary code belonging to a current or former employer or client.

jobs.title: Senior Hypersonics & Advanced Propulsion Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** iRocket is seeking a highly motivated and technically accomplished **Hypersonics \& Advanced Propulsion Engineer** to support the development of next\-generation hypersonic flight systems, advanced propulsion technologies, and solid rocket motors (SRMs). This is an opportunity for an engineer with a strong background in hypersonics, high\-speed aerodynamics, propulsion, thermal protection, or experimental aerospace systems to contribute to challenging aerospace and defense programs while expanding their technical expertise into solid rocket motor engineering. **The ideal candidate will have experience in both hypersonic technologies and solid rocket motors. However, prior SRM experience is not required for candidates with strong hypersonics backgrounds who are enthusiastic about learning and contributing to SRM design, development, manufacturing, and testing.** We are looking for an engineer who enjoys solving difficult technical problems, developing real hardware, participating in testing, and taking engineering concepts from initial design through demonstration. **Key Responsibilities** **Hypersonics \& Advanced Flight Systems** * Support the research, design, development, and testing of hypersonic and high\-speed aerospace systems. * Perform or support aerodynamic, aerothermal, thermal, structural, and propulsion\-system analyses for high\-speed flight applications. * Contribute to the development of hypersonic vehicle concepts, propulsion integration, launch architectures, and flight\-test systems. * Evaluate thermal protection systems (TPS), high\-temperature materials, and structural solutions for extreme flight environments. * Support experimental testing, ground demonstrations, flight\-test planning, instrumentation, data collection, and post\-test analysis. * Work on high\-speed flight vehicle integration, launch\-system interfaces, and advanced payload deployment concepts. * Collaborate with internal engineering teams, suppliers, research partners, and government customers to advance hypersonic capabilities. **Solid Rocket Motor Development \& Cross\-Training** * Work alongside iRocket's SRM engineering and propulsion teams to develop expertise in solid rocket motor systems. * Participate in SRM design, analysis, manufacturing, assembly, testing, and qualification activities. * Develop knowledge of SRM internal ballistics, motor cases, nozzles, insulation, ignition systems, and propellant grain design. * Support propulsion\-system integration, structural and thermal analysis, and engineering trade studies. * Participate in static\-fire tests, instrumentation, data analysis, hardware inspection, and engineering improvements. * Progressively assume greater responsibility across both hypersonics and SRM programs, with opportunities to contribute to complete propulsion\-system development. **Engineering Execution \& Program Development** * Translate technical requirements into engineering analyses, hardware designs, test plans, and development activities. * Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering, manufacturing, and testing teams. * Support technical design reviews, customer presentations, proposals, and program execution. * Identify technical risks, troubleshoot development challenges, and recommend practical engineering solutions. * Help transition advanced propulsion technologies from early development into repeatable manufacturing and production. **Requirements** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering field. Master's or Ph.D. preferred. * Relevant engineering experience in hypersonics, high\-speed aerospace systems, advanced propulsion, aerothermodynamics, or related technologies. * Demonstrated technical involvement in at least one relevant aerospace development, analysis, research, or testing program. * Strong understanding of engineering fundamentals, including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, propulsion, heat transfer, structural mechanics, or combustion. * Experience with engineering analysis, simulation, mechanical design, experimental testing, or hardware development. * Ability to work collaboratively across multiple engineering disciplines and solve technical problems independently. * **Strong interest in developing expertise in solid rocket motors and willingness to work across both hypersonics and SRM programs.** * Willingness to participate in hands\-on development, manufacturing activities, and ground or flight testing. * Ability to work on\-site in New York or Texas and travel to test facilities as required. * Ability to meet applicable U.S. export\-control requirements for assigned work. **Highly Desired Experience** Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are strongly encouraged to apply: **Hypersonics \& High\-Speed Flight** * Hypersonic vehicle design, aerodynamic analysis, or high\-speed flight testing. * Hypersonic thermal protection systems and high\-temperature materials. * Ramjet, scramjet, solid\-fuel ramjet, or rotating detonation propulsion research and development. * Hypersonic wind tunnels, high\-enthalpy testing, hot\-air tunnels, or experimental propulsion facilities. * Aerothermal modeling, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), finite element analysis (FEA), and flight\-performance modeling. * Rocket\-boosted flight vehicles, launch systems, or experimental flight\-test platforms. **Solid Rocket Motors \& Missile Propulsion** * Solid rocket motor design, development, integration, or qualification. * Experience with motor cases, nozzles, insulation, ignition systems, or solid propellant systems. * SRM static\-fire testing, flight testing, or performance analysis. * Tactical missile propulsion, interceptor propulsion, or rocket motor manufacturing. * Transitioning prototype propulsion systems into production. **Additional Valuable Skills** * Experience using ANSYS, Fluent, CFX, STAR\-CCM\+, MATLAB, Python, SolidWorks, or comparable engineering tools. * Additive manufacturing, advanced materials, and design for manufacturability. * Defense research programs, government\-funded aerospace development, or technical proposal preparation. * Demonstrated experience working across multidisciplinary design, development, and testing activities. **What Makes a Strong Candidate?** We value engineers who combine technical depth with curiosity, adaptability, and an interest in hands\-on development. You may already have expertise in hypersonic flight systems, thermal protection, ramjet propulsion, or experimental aerospace testing but have limited experience with conventional solid rocket motors. Alternatively, you may have developed rocket motors or missile propulsion systems and want to expand into hypersonic technologies. **We are particularly interested in candidates who can eventually contribute meaningfully to both disciplines, from engineering analysis and development through manufacturing and testing.** Experience in both disciplines is a significant advantage, but a demonstrated ability to learn and execute is equally important. **Why Join iRocket?** * Work on challenging aerospace and defense propulsion technologies with applications across hypersonics, missile defense, and advanced flight systems. * Gain hands\-on exposure to multiple propulsion technologies rather than being limited to a single engineering specialty. * Participate in real hardware development, integrated testing, and manufacturing activities. * Work alongside experienced propulsion engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams. * Help develop emerging aerospace technologies while supporting existing propulsion and manufacturing programs. * Opportunity for significant technical ownership and career growth as engineering programs expand. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer / Technical Lead** **LOCATION** **Hybrid · Orlando, FL** **SALARY** **$110K – $160K** **REPORTS TO** **Founder \& CEO** **RELOCATION** **Expenses Covered** JOB SUMMARY BidBuddy is a software platform that helps property managers manage requests for proposals, communicate with vendors, receive bids, and compare proposals using AI\-assisted tools. We are bringing software development in\-house after working with an external development firm. We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to take technical ownership of the existing platform and lead its continued development. This role combines full\-stack development, AWS infrastructure management, and practical technical leadership. You will work directly with the founder to understand customer needs, prioritize improvements, and deliver reliable features. **This is a hands\-on development role—not a management\-only position.** We need someone comfortable working independently across an existing codebase, investigating problems, making sound technical decisions, and owning features from planning through production. DUTIES ▪ Lead a structured technical handoff from our current development partner, including the codebase, architecture, cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, integrations, and outstanding work. ▪ Take ownership of the existing application, improving it incrementally rather than assuming it requires a complete rewrite. ▪ Develop and maintain frontend features using React and TypeScript, and backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS Lambda. ▪ Improve workflows for property managers and vendors, including RFP creation, vendor invitations, bid submissions, document handling, proposal comparisons, and messaging. ▪ Develop and maintain APIs, data models, authentication, and role\-based access controls. ▪ Maintain AWS infrastructure, including DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and serverless services, using AWS CDK. ▪ Improve AI\-assisted document and bid\-analysis workflows, with attention to accuracy, source evidence, processing costs, and failure handling. ▪ Maintain automated deployments through GitHub Actions and strengthen testing, code review, and release practices. ▪ Monitor application reliability, troubleshoot production issues, and manage cloud and third\-party service costs. ▪ Protect confidential customer and vendor information through appropriate permissions, secure development practices, and careful data handling. ▪ Translate business requirements into clear implementation plans, communicate tradeoffs, and provide realistic delivery estimates. ▪ Document the system so the company retains technical knowledge and can onboard additional engineers as it grows. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Substantial professional experience developing and maintaining production web applications. ▪ Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Node.js. ▪ Hands\-on experience building, deploying, and supporting applications on AWS, particularly serverless architectures. ▪ Experience with APIs, authentication, authorization, and database design. ▪ Experience with DynamoDB or comparable NoSQL databases. ▪ Familiarity with infrastructure as code, automated deployment pipelines, Git, and automated testing. ▪ Demonstrated ability to understand and improve an existing application developed by another team. ▪ Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and explain technical decisions clearly to a business\-focused founder. ▪ A practical approach to balancing development speed, reliability, security, and cost. ▪ Willingness to write and maintain code as the primary technical owner. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ▪ Experience taking over an application from an agency, consulting firm, or previous engineering team. ▪ Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS platforms serving different user roles. ▪ Experience integrating LLMs into production applications, including structured outputs, evidence validation, evaluation, and usage\-cost management. ▪ Experience with PDF processing, document extraction, or comparison workflows. ▪ Familiarity with Material UI, TanStack Query, Hono, Zod, OpenAI, LangChain, or Ably. ▪ Experience in property management, construction, procurement, or vendor\-management software. ▪ Experience establishing engineering practices for a small company and helping hire or mentor additional developers. CURRENT TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT BidBuddy’s existing codebase includes: **Frontend** React, TypeScript, Vite, and Material UI **Backend** Node.js, TypeScript, Hono, and AWS Lambda **Data \& Infrastructure** DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, and AWS CDK **Development \& Deployment** GitHub, GitHub Actions, and a monorepo with shared packages **AI \& Document Workflows** OpenAI and LangChain **Real\-Time Communication** Ably and WebSocket functionality *Experience with every individual library is not required. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to take ownership of the overall system are more important.* INITIAL PRIORITIES — FIRST 90 DAYS During the first 90 days, you will be expected to: **1\.** Complete the technical transition and establish independent development and deployment capability. **2\.** Document the architecture, service dependencies, and operational procedures. **3\.** Identify and prioritize the most important technical risks and product improvements. **4\.** Deliver agreed\-upon improvements through a repeatable testing and release process. **5\.** Establish a practical development roadmap with the founder. WORK ARRANGEMENT \& COMPENSATION **Location:** Hybrid, combining in\-person work at our Orlando, FL headquarters with remote work. **Relocation:** BidBuddy will cover relocation expenses for candidates moving to the Orlando area. **Base salary:** $110,000 – $160,000 per year, depending on experience. HOW TO APPLY Please provide your résumé and a brief description of: **1\.** An application you personally helped build and maintain, including your specific responsibilities. **2\.** Your experience with React, TypeScript, and AWS. **3\.** A time you inherited an existing codebase or took over work from another team. **4\.** Any experience with AI\-powered document processing or SaaS platforms. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Relocation assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Orlando, FL 32827

jobs.title: Senior Optomechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Onsite — Austin, TX **Employment Type:** Direct Hire, Full\-Time **Job Title:** Senior Optomechanical Engineer **About 9 Mothers** The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top\-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real\-time. Our flagship product is a low\-power, counter\-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. **Why 9 Mothers?** While others build for "awareness" or "long\-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission\-driven builders who value field\-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. **Position Summary** * We are hiring a Senior Optomechanical Engineer to own the optics\-related subsystems on our robotic weapon platforms: the cameras, thermal imagers, rangefinders, and sensor heads that let our systems find and engage small drones, and the windows, housings, and mounts that keep them working. This role exists because our optics have to hold alignment and image quality on a machine that fires shotguns, slews hard, and lives outdoors in Texas heat, dust, and rain. * This is not an optical design role. Our lens trains are designed by others, inside and outside the company. Your job is everything that happens to those optics once they leave the designer: how they are held, aligned, sealed, kept clean and dry, protected from shock and vibration, and made to perform the same at 0 °F as they do at 140 °F. You are the person who makes sure we get every bit of performance the optical designer put on paper, and you are the person who tells the designer early when a prescription will not survive the mount it needs. * The person we want thinks in degrees of freedom. You know where an optic is constrained and where it is free to move, how much it will move with temperature and load, and what that does to focus, boresight, and MTF. You have strong opinions on bonded versus clamped versus flexure mounts, and the experience to back them. You know what Invar, titanium, and stainless buy you over aluminum, and you know when aluminum is the right answer because the error budget allows it and the price does not. * This is a hands\-on role. You will build and align your own assemblies, put them on the shaker and in the thermal chamber, take them to the range, and measure what moved. **Essential Duties** * **Own the optical subsystems.** Be the responsible engineer for every sensor head, camera module, and optical window on the platform, from concept and requirements through production and field support. Own the optomechanical error budget and the drawings, ICDs, and test procedures that go with it. * **Mount optics properly.** Design kinematic, semi\-kinematic, flexure, bonded, and retained mounts for lenses, windows, mirrors, filters, and focal plane assemblies. Control preload, bond line thickness, and stress birefringence. Make mounts that can be aligned once and stay aligned. * **Choose materials on purpose.** Select housing, cell, spacer, and fastener materials to balance CTE match, stiffness, mass, machinability, corrosion, and cost. Run the athermalization math for focus and boresight, and make the cost\-versus\-stability call with numbers behind it. * **Manage shock and vibration.** Design for weapon recoil, gunfire shock, and gimbal slew loads. Drive structural modes away from excitation, specify or design isolation where it helps, and keep line\-of\-sight jitter and boresight shift within budget. Run modal and structural FEA and correlate it to test. * **Keep it clean and dry.** Design sealed, purged, and desiccated housings that keep moisture, dust, and contaminants off the glass for years in the field. Specify seals, breathers, purge and fill procedures, window coatings, and anti\-fog and window\-clearing approaches. Set up the clean assembly practices and handling procedures our technicians will follow. * **Align and boresight**. Develop alignment and co\-boresighting methods and fixtures for multiple sensors on a common mount and to the weapon. Make alignment repeatable on a production floor, not just on your bench. * **Work with the optical designers.** Turn lens prescriptions into buildable assemblies. Feed tolerance sensitivities and mechanical constraints back early. Support integrated structural\-thermal\-optical (STOP) analysis where it earns its keep. * **Test and prove it.** Plan and run thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, and water\-ingress testing on optical assemblies. Measure what moved, in focus, boresight, and image quality, and close the loop into the next revision. * **Make it manufa  shock and vibration experience: modal analysis, random vibration and shock response, isolation, preload design, and the test methods to verify them (MIL\-STD\-810 or equivalent). You know the difference between a mount that passes the shaker and a mount that holds boresight after it. * Experience designing and building sealed optical housings: O\-ring and gasket design, dry nitrogen purge, desiccants, pressure equalization, window selection and mounting, and contamination control during assembly. * Fluency with optical tolerance and error budgets. You can read a lens prescription and drawing, understand which tolerances matter, and translate image\-quality and boresight requirements into mechanical requirements. * Proficiency in FEA (modal, structural, thermal) and the judgment to know when the model is wrong. * Strong GD\&T and drawing skills. Your drawings fully define an optical assembly and suppliers can build to them. * Hands\-on alignment and test skills: autocollimators, collimators, alignment telescopes, interferometry or MTF benches, and building your own fixtures when the right one does not exist. * A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, optical engineering, or physics, or equivalent experience. * Efficient, low\-ego, and easy to work with. You say no clearly when a design will not survive, and you move work forward without drama. **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with weapon\-mounted or gun\-fire\-exposed optics: fire control sensors, weapon sights, remote weapon stations, or gimbaled EO/IR turrets. * Experience with infrared optics and windows (germanium, ZnS, ZnSe, chalcogenides, sapphire) and their mounting, coating, and thermal quirks. Experience integrating uncooled thermal cores. * Experience with laser rangefinders or other active optical systems, including transmit/receive boresight. * STOP analysis experience with tools such as Zemax OpticStudio, Code V, or Sigmadyne SigFit. * Experience with gimbal and stabilized\-platform design, where structural stiffness and line\-of\-sight stability drive the architecture. * Experience taking optical assemblies from prototype into rate production, including vendor qualification and production alignment fixtures. * An interest in firearms and the problems they create for everything bolted to them. * Experience in a venture\-backed hardware startup. **Benefits** * **Meaningful Early Equity:** You aren't just an employee; you are a foundational owner. Your contributions directly drive the value of your stake in the company. * **Direct Roadmap Influence:** Forget the bureaucracy of big defense. You will have a seat at the table, directly shaping our product and technology trajectory from day one. * **Mission\-Critical Work:** We don't build for "what if." We build systems the Department of War actively needs to counter immediate, real\-world threats. * **The Builder's Playground:** Work in a brand\-new lab fully optimized for rapid prototyping, equipped with NVIDIA Jetsons, high\-end scopes, and 3\-D printers. * **100% Employer\-Paid Premiums:** We cover 100% of your medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums and cover 50% of healthcare premiums for your dependents. * **Unlimited PTO:** We value results, not clock\-watching. Take the time you need to stay sharp and recharge. * **Zero Red Tape:** You have the autonomy to make technical decisions that would take months of committee approval at a larger firm. * **Austin\-Based Culture:** Join an onsite team in Austin, TX, where we prioritize high\-bandwidth collaboration and rapid field\-testing. * **Relocation Assistance:** We want the best talent in the room. If you aren't in Austin yet, we’ll help you get here, to make your transition to the Silicon Hills seamless. **About the Interview** * Initial screen with recruiter (30 min phone call) * Virtual interview with Director of Hardware Operations (30 min via MS Teams) * Onsite interview at our Austin facility (1 hour in\-person) Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. We specializes in custom\-engineered vacuum and pressure systems, offering advanced solutions for complex applications in life sciences, electronics, and industrial automation. Known for flexibility and technical expertise, Airtech partners with customers to solve unique challenges and deliver tailored systems that meet demanding performance requirements. Airtech combine engineering excellence, customer focus, and global reach to enable technologies that keep industries moving and improve everyday life. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Electrical Engineer is responsible for developing motor\-control algorithms and advanced electrical systems that power high\-speed rotating equipment. jobs.title: Custom ERC/Power-Intent Automation CAD Engineer
jobs.description: Interested in how Apple designs the world’s most advanced silicon? We’re looking for an engineer who will bring passion for hardware and strong programming skills to our team of CAD engineers. You’ll develop, maintain and enhance custom analog power intent methodology and circuit ERC solutions for transistor level analysis on Analog, RF and mixed\-signal designs. In this role, you will have the opportunity to directly influence the circuit design on various technology nodes and develop CAD flows for circuit recognition, topology identification, netlist tracing, power domain interactions, and analyze electrical rule checks. Your contributions will be instrumental in the analog, mixed\-signal, and RF circuit design teams. You will lead and oversee efforts in developing and validating custom circuit checker flows, enhancing the custom design environment, validating checks, and conducting results analysis. As you collaborate with layout design, technology, and third\-party EDA tool vendors, your expertise will be invaluable in driving innovation and ensuring the success of these initiatives. The successful candidate will excel in dynamic, collaborative working environments and exhibit a hands\-on, enthusiastic, self\-motivated approach, with a strong drive to succeed in challenging settings. If you are eager to tackle challenges with innovative solutions, deliver exceptional user experiences, and pay meticulous attention to detail, this role may be the perfect fit for you. As a member of our team, your contributions will directly impact the experiences of millions of Apple customers in delivering state of the art processors to the wide range of Apple products. **Description** In this highly visible role, your primary responsibilities will include: Developing innovative solutions on Circuit ERC (Electric Rules checks) or Power Intent analysis leveraging expertise on circuits and programming. Actively involving yourself in supporting ERC/Power Intent on voltage domain interactions like \- supply gating mechanisms, isolation controls, level shifting, switch supplies, virtual domain interactions, power integrity etc. Closely collaborating with diverse design teams, including Custom Analog, Mixed\-Signal, Digital, RF and more, to understand their needs and requirements on circuit ERC and power flows. jobs.title: Senior System Level Verification Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Components Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** It’s about the journey. Whether it’s a bus ride or flight, our commercial electronic systems help transport millions of passengers every day. Every second a plane takes off somewhere in the world, enabled by our flight\-critical products. Be part of our journey at Electronic Systems where you’ll be among the brightest minds, working on the industry’s most difficult problems. Drawing strength from our differences, we’re innovating for the future. Now you can too. Our flexible work environment provides you a chance to change the world without giving up your personal life. We put our customers first – exemplified by our mission: “We Innovate For Those Who Move The World™.” Sound like a team you want to be a part of? Come build your career with BAE Systems. BAE Systems is seeking a Components Engineer for our Controls and Avionics Solutions (CAS) business located in Fort Wayne, IN. Being a trusted provider of commercial aircraft solutions, the CAS business also develops and produces highly reliable, adaptable, and scalable avionics solutions for the leading manufacturers of commercial aircraft and their propulsion systems. As a member of the BAE Systems’ team, you will have the opportunity to work hands\-on with complex electronic controls and solve challenging technical problems that enhance our product’s performance and reliability to the delight of our customers. In this Components Engineer role, the qualified candidate will be the engineering design support interface for electronic and/or mechanical components within the Fort Wayne factory. The qualified candidate will have an electronic and/or mechanical background and project leadership experience to provide design support for components used in the manufacturing of commercial aerospace controls and electronics. Day\-to\-day activities will include providing liaison engineering support – technical engineering guidance and project leadership – for aircraft electronic control components between the design engineering organization in Endicott, NY and the Air Transport (AT) Operations teams in Fort Wayne, IN and Guaymas, MX, as well as working with our customers (Boeing) and numerous suppliers. The goals of this role involve sustaining the component pipeline for our products in an ever evolving electronics world. Responsibilities include: * Defining, evaluating, and maintaining component performance requirements for electronic and mechanical components. * Coordinating resolution of component obsolescence and shortages alongside design engineering and program management, including drafting configuration change documentation and substantiation. * Performing electrical analysis, derating, reliability assessments, and environmental qualification testing in support of design changes and production issues. * Leading projects to qualify alternate and second\-source components through electrical, reliability, and environmental analysis to support existing designs’ performance. * Leading value engineering projects with customers and suppliers on cost/risk reduction and producibility. * Liaising with Design Engineering in Endicott, New York on design changes. * Mentoring junior engineers on component analysis, qualification, and problem solving. Performance in the role requires strong engagement with Programs, Operations, and Supply Chain to support component performance, quality, reliability, and delivery issues. Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in\-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite in the Fort Wayne, IN manufacturing facility and remote. Some light travel may be required (\<10%) **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent degree with at least 4 years experience. * General understanding of electronic and mechanical components and their associated datasheets. * Ability to read and interpret engineering documentation (e.g. requirements, schematics, drawings, test procedures). * General understanding of electronics’ manufacturing process. * Proven technical understanding of programmable, electronic, mechanical, and/or electromechanical components and their use in design applications. * Familiarity with statistical process control techniques and analytical tools (ex. 6 Sigma). * Demonstrated ability to coordinate and organize multiple activities in a team environment. * Adept at methodical problem solving to true root cause with demonstrated critical thinking applied. * Effective communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * Greenbelt certified in statistical process control techniques. * Demonstrated project leadership skills. * Experience working in a high energy, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Demonstrated use of complex analytical tools * Familiarity with the manufacturing and/or test of high reliability circuit card assemblies. * Familiarity with electronic component programming processes and tools. * Familiarity with component reliability and aerospace testing (e.g. DO\-160 or MIL\-STD\-810\). * Familiarity with Material Review Board (MRB) quality disposition processes. * Excellent interpersonal skills (customers, peers, management, suppliers). **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $79370 \- $134929 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience. Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters. This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

The ideal candidate possesses knowledge of a broad spectrum of compute hardware and mobility technologies as well as Linux, Kubernetes, and related orchestration frameworks like Openshift. In this role you will: * Independently handle high\-priority customer escalations to solve, diagnose, and debug UCS compute hardware, Mobility applications, and core network issue. * Work closely with Hardware and Software Engineering to work toward problem resolution and to address customer issues. * Drive customer satisfaction and for providing product improvement feedback to Engineering teams. * Establish strong working relationships with the global Mobility TAC and UCS TAC/escalation teams. * The MCBU escalation team covers all time zones. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: IT Support Specialist
jobs.description: **Description of Primary Purpose** ---------------------------------- **Primary Purpose:** Serves as the initial point of contact for City staff seeking technical support City\-wide. Troubleshoots and resolves hardware, software, network, and telecommunication issues to ensure reliable IT service delivery across all departments. Functions as a versatile, first\-tier, jack\-of\-all\-trades technical resource, able to quickly learn new systems and technologies and provide effective support to staff at every level of the organization, from front\-line employees to senior leadership. Assists with the onboarding and rollout of new technologies to support successful adoption City\-wide. Manages relationships with IT vendors and coordinates procurement, invoicing, and billing for IT products and services. **Supervision Received:** Works under the direct supervision of the Manager of Information Technology (IT) with tasks and some responsibilities assigned by the City's Senior Systems Administrator and Senior Network Systems Engineer. **Supervision Exercised:** Minimal supervision exercised on projects where IT has leadership role. IMRF pension eligible. Expected hiring range $78,235 \+/\- dependent on qualifications. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- * Provide Tier 1 help desk support City\-wide for all City departments. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to computers, software, printers, phones, voicemail, and related systems. Escalate complex issues to appropriate IT staff. * Serve as a primary point of contact for selected IT vendor relationships. Coordinate service requests, warranty claims, and support tickets with hardware, software, and telecommunications vendors. Maintain vendor contact records and relationships. * Process and track IT\-related invoices, purchase orders, and recurring service billing. Reconcile vendor invoices against contracts and quotes. Maintain accurate records of IT expenditures and assist IT leadership with budget tracking and forecasting. * Install, configure, and maintain Devices, operating systems, software, and network connections City\-wide. Assist with inventory and repair of IT assets across all departments. * Maintain systems such as the IT Help Desk, Asset Management, and Software Licensing. Develop and update procedures for key systems and maintain accurate license and warranty records. Assist with onboarding, testing, and phased rollout of new technologies and platforms to support successful City\-wide adoption. * Research IT products, services, and solutions based on user and technical specifications. Obtain quotes, compare vendor proposals, and provide purchasing recommendations to IT leadership. * Perform other related duties as assigned. **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- ***Required Minimum Qualifications:*** *The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* **Education:** Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required. College coursework combined with relevant professional certifications may substitute for the degree requirement. **Experience:** Three to five years of IT support experience, with demonstrated strength in troubleshooting, customer service, and documentation. Demonstrated experience coordinating with vendors, processing invoices, or supporting procurement/purchasing activities. Demonstrated experience supporting technology users at all levels of an organization, from front\-line staff to senior leadership. **Certification or License:** Valid driver's license is required. We encourage candidates to demonstrate their commitment to professional growth through relevant IT certifications. Examples might include CompTIA A\+ or Network\+, Cisco's CCNA or other networking certifications, Microsoft or Google Cloud credentials, or any other industry\-recognized certifications. These are not mandatory, but they reflect a dedication to staying current in the field and continuously developing your technical expertise. **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Proficiencies****:** * Knowledge of hardware and software components of servers, personal computers, and mobile devices * Proficiency in troubleshooting user issues across diverse systems and platforms * Ability to document technical procedures and IT support processes clearly and accurately * Effective interpersonal and communication skills to explain technical issues to non\-technical users * Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities independently * Capacity\-building mindset, able to walk users through solutions to reduce reliance on IT support * Availability for on\-call support during off\-hours for critical IT issues and emergencies * Strong time management, customer service orientation, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to build and maintain productive working relationships with IT vendors and service providers * Skill in reviewing invoices, purchase orders, and vendor contracts for accuracy * Basic understanding of municipal procurement and budgeting practices, or willingness to learn * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in tracking expenditures and vendor records * Versatile, adaptable, and comfortable serving as a jack\-of\-all\-trades across a wide range of technical disciplines * Quick to learn new systems, technologies, and processes independently and apply them on the job * Experience assisting with the onboarding and rollout of new technology platforms, including testing, training, and phased implementation Ability to effectively support and communicate with staff at all levels of the organization, from front\-line employees to senior leadership * **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- **Physical Demands****:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk and hear. The employee is required to walk; use hands to finger motions, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is required to withstand prolonged periods of concentration, necessitated by activities such as proof reading, comparison analysis and data entry. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. **Tools and Equipment Used****:** Operates a variety of office and IT\-related equipment and systems, including desktop and laptop computers and mobile devices utilizing Windows, Microsoft 365, Linux, iOS, Android, and related platforms; Microsoft Office applications; financial ERP systems such as Tyler Munis, including purchasing and accounts payable modules; reporting tools such as SQL Server Reporting Services; multi\-function printers, copiers, scanners, VOIP phones, tablets, telephones, calculators, and other general office equipment. Also utilizes specialized IT infrastructure and tools, including firewalls, switches, routers, VMware virtualization software, Microsoft Server and SQL Server environments, Tyler Munis, EnerGov and related applications, Mitel and AVST voicemail systems and modern cloud\-based communication platforms such as Zoom Phone, RingCentral, and Microsoft Teams, electronic diagnostic and testing equipment, security tools such as CrowdStrike, Duo, and Barracuda products, and vendor portals, procurement and purchase order systems, and invoice tracking tools.

jobs.title: Engineer I/II
jobs.description: **OPPORTUNITY** --------------- *This is an open recruitment to fill one full\-time Engineer I/II position.* *The Engineer I/II position is a flex\-series position.* *Candidates may be hired at either level based on their experience and the hiring department's needs.* **Biweekly Salary Ranges** **Engineer I:** $3,277\.44 \- $3,983\.75 **Engineer II:** $3,613\.40 \- $4,392\.11 **WHO WE ARE \& WHAT WE DO** The City of Santa Maria is a full\-service city with a City Council/City Manager form of government, over 700 employees, an annual budget of approximately $367 million, and serves approximately 113,041 constituents. Santa Maria is located on the beautiful central coast of California and covers over 23 square miles. The City harmoniously balances maintaining agricultural and coastal lands while promoting business. The City of Santa Maria has been recognized nationally as an All\-America City by the National Civic League and offers community festivals, reasonably priced housing, and quality schools. Santa Maria is in proximity to a local airport, beaches, cultural arts, institutions of higher education, and wineries. The Department of Public Works is responsible for ensuring that City\-owned transportation infrastructure and facilities, transit services, and capital improvement programs are designed, engineered, constructed, maintained, and/or modified in a presentable and safe condition. The department coordinates a variety of activities and services, including the preparation of plans and specifications for public works\-related construction projects; the design and inspection of public facilities; and ensuring the proper installation of all public improvements made in new subdivisions, such as streets, curbs, gutters, sidewalks, water mains, sewer lines, and drainage. **ABOUT THE POSITION** Under the general direction of the assigned supervisor, assists in the planning, coordination, analysis, and implementation of various activities of the Public Works Department in one of the following divisions: construction, development, traffic and transportation, or capital. This classification may be flexibly staffed at the discretion of the Department Director. Supervision is not normally a responsibility of this classification, but the incumbent may act as lead worker for temporarily assigned employees or special projects. The Engineer I/II position is an Individual Contributor role that provides design and engineering services to ensure City\-owned infrastructure, assets, and facilities are constructed and modified in a functional and safe condition. Their role enables City of Santa Maria residents to enjoy a healthy, safe, and pleasant environment in which to live, work, and play. **THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** The ideal candidate is a collaborative, enthusiastic, and forward\-thinking engineering professional with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related field and a strong foundation in engineering principles, practices, and methods. The successful candidate will bring curiosity, initiative, and problem\-solving skills to a variety of municipal projects involving capital improvement projects, development review, public infrastructure, transportation, and related public works activities. While some engineering experience is desirable, the City of Santa Maria welcomes candidates who demonstrate a commitment to learning and possess strong technical fundamentals. The ideal candidate will build productive relationships, communicate effectively, and work collaboratively with consultants, contractors, the community, and city staff. The ideal candidate will exhibit enthusiasm for innovation, professional growth, and public service, and the opportunity to help shape and maintain the infrastructure that sustains the community and its quality of life. **REQUIRED APPLICATION ATTACHMENTS** * Cover Letter * Resume * Copy of Engineer\-in\-Training Certificate **DUTIES** ---------- These duties are a representative example; position assignments may vary depending on the business needs of the department and organization. This position: * Performs sub\-professional civil engineering field and office work, including utilizing computer\-aided drafting software to prepare and produce engineering drawings and other computer input. * Participates in the development and administration of the division or section budget. * Consults with and aids other governmental agencies in engineering matters. * Receives citizen complaints and takes appropriate action. * Represents the division or department at conferences and meetings with other departments, agencies, and organizations. * Composes correspondence to policymakers, lending institutions, bonding companies, contractors, developers, regulatory agencies, etc. * Develops written reports, correspondence, change orders, technical memos, applications, permits, and other written information. * Demonstrates regular, reliable, and punctual attendance. * Upholds the values of the organizatio knowledge, skills and motivation to improve the quality of their lives and well\-being. The City's Wellness Program includes ergonomic evaluations, flu shots, and Wellness Workshops during lunch and after work. Access to the Paul Nelson Aquatics Center for employee and immediate family members. Access to the Weight room at the Abel Maldonado Community Youth Center for employee and immediate family members. Access to employee discounts and special offers on travel, entertainment, shopping, dining and services. **Mentorship Program** This professional development program of mentoring and job shadowing provides mentees with an opportunity to be mentored by experienced staff with the objective of developing specific skills and knowledge that will enhance the participants' leadership skills and promote professional growth. **Succession Planning** The academies are offered to all employees including those that are not yet in a supervisory role, but are interested in becoming leaders within the organization as well as our executive management team who have an interest in honing their skills and helping to prepare our future leaders. In addition to multiple leadership academies, the City offers quarterly Speaker Series, a corporate Toastmasters club available for City employees, site tours of various departments, and more. **Deferred Compensation** Employees may participate in the City's 457 Deferred Compensation Plan sponsored by either Empower or CalPERS Supplemental Income. The plan enables employees to save salary and earn interest on a tax\-deferred basis. A City match is available based upon representation. The City also provides an IRS approved 401(a) plan sponsored by Empower for managers represented by Non\-Represented Full\-Time Management \& Confidential (NMAC). **Post Employment Health Plan (PEHP)** Based upon your bargaining unit the City may participate in a PEHP plan that will provide reimbursement for out\-of\-pocket cost of qualified medical expenses such as prescription drugs, doctor co\-pays, eyeglasses and cover the reimbursement of medical insurance premiums upon separation or retirement. **Holidays** The City offers seven (7\) paid holidays per year. In addition, based upon your bargaining unit a bank of floating holiday hours is available to be used at the employee's discretion. **Vacation** The City initially offers two weeks of paid vacation per calendar year for all full time employees. Accrual rates increase thereafter based upon your bargaining unit. **Sick Leave** Sick leave shall accrue a rate of eight hours for each month of continuous service, or approximately two weeks per year for all full time employees. Employees may use up to half of their annually accrued sick leave for family illness and up to five days (40 hours) per calendar year for bereavement leave. **Management Leave** Management level employees may receive a prorated amount of management leave time each new calendar year. **Educational Incentive Program** In addition to regular pay when education is in addition to the regular requirements of the job specifications and is work related. **Tuition Reimbursement** Based on your bargaining unit, you may be reimbursed for tuition and book costs of approved job related courses. The maximum amount of tuition reimbursement in any calendar year will vary based upon your bargaining unit. **Auto Allowance** Management level employees may receive auto allowance based upon the need of the position. **Telephone/PDA Stipend** Management level employees may receive a telephone and/or PDA stipend based upon the need of the position. **Bilingual Pay** Bilingual pay is provided to employees who are required by their department head to use both English and Spanish in communicating with the public while performing the duties of his/her position and who demonstrate appropriate skills in both speaking and understanding the Spanish language shall receive compensation. The benefit amount varies per bargaining unit.

jobs.title: Jr Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Cavaliers Holdings LLC is obsessed with delivering epic experiences for our team members, our fans, our community and the world. Fueled by an unapologetically bold, inclusive and high\-impact culture, we strive to recruit individuals who are enthusiastic and purposeful in carrying out our vision as transformative leaders in sports and entertainment. If you are ready to bring your best to the dynamic, high performance environment of the Cavs, Sirens, Monsters, Charge, RESN and Rocket Arena \- where we come together to create moments that move, inspire, and uplift \- then we want to hear from you. **JOB SUMMARY:** We're hiring a Jr Data Quality Engineer for our IT Products team. This is an entry\-level role that handles manual data operations: SQL queries, exports, and file exchanges for business teams in Ticketing, Marketing, Sales, and Business Intelligence. We are automating parts of this work into self\-service data products and adopting Databricks as our data platform. We want this person to see data operations as the backbone of our future data products and business partnerships. This is an engineering role, not a data\-entry role, and the expectation is that this person grows into the data engineer who builds and maintains those self\-service data products. \*\* Visa sponsorship will not be offered for this role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. \*\* This is an onsite position. Candidates must reside in Cleveland, OH or be willing to fully relocate to Cleveland, OH. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Fulfill data requests from business teams across Ticketing, Marketing, Sales, and Business Intelligence: queries, one\-off exports, segmentation pulls. * Execute manual data imports and file exchanges accurately, with a clear audit trail every time. * Document every repeatable process in enough detail that a future script could replace it. * Flag data quality issues during fulfillment work and route them to the right owner with context\- familiarity with data quality concepts like null handling, deduplication, referential integrity is a plus. * Partner with Full\-Stack Data Engineers to convert documented manual processes into automated, self\-service data products. * Support data stewardship help maintain field definitions, surface gaps, and keep documentation current. * Write and maintain basic SQL scripts for recurring requests, with an eye toward what should eventually become a self\-service data product instead of a one\-off request. * Assist in validation, spot\-checking, and ad\-hoc investigation when data anomalies surface. * Handle vendor data file exchanges with care and accountability. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Software Engineering, etc.). * 1\+ year(s) of experience working directly with data in a professional environment (internship experience is welcomed). * Willingness to work onsite in an office environment minimum of 4 days per week. * Strong SQL: you write joins, debug other people's queries, and structure a data pull without handholding. * Fluent in relational databases — PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar. * Process\-minded by instinct: you document what you do before someone asks you to. * Organized and reliable — business teams will depend on you for time\-sensitive fulfillment work. * Clear communicator: you can explain a data issue to someone who doesn't write SQL. * Basic Python or scripting exposure is a plus, even if it's just a simple script. * Exposure to any BI tool, data warehouse platform, or Databricks specifically is a plus. This posting will expire on Friday 10/16, or once a maximum amount of applicants has been reached. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class. Actual compensation will depend on your experience, education/credentials, skills, and how they fit our organizational needs. Rock Entertainment Group offers a robust perks package with healthcare, dental, vision, retirement, and more!

jobs.title: Broadcast Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** **About the Role** Control AV, LLC is a design\-build systems integrator serving the cruise industry, delivering entertainment, broadcast, and communications systems for both shipyards and vessel owners across newbuild construction and refit/drydock projects. We are seeking an experienced Broadcast Engineer to lead the design and commissioning of shipboard broadcast systems, spanning both the headend/distribution infrastructure that delivers content to guest and crew spaces, and the onboard production and studio systems used for live events, local origination content, and in\-house programming. This role sits at the intersection of engineering design, shipyard project execution, and hands\-on systems commissioning — working internal, shipyard, and owner's technical teams to deliver broadcast systems from concept through vessel delivery. **Responsibilities:** **Distribution \& Headend Engineering** * Develop and review broadcast system designs, including headend architecture, IPTV distribution, satellite reception (TVRO), and RF/fiber backbone infrastructure * Produce and review technical drawings, single\-line diagrams, cable schedules, and equipment specifications in coordination with internal, owner, and shipyard engineering teams * Specify headend equipment (encoders, multiplexers, IRDs, modulators) and integrate with shipwide entertainment systems and digital signage platforms * Support design reviews with shipyards, owner representatives, and classification societies **Live Production \& Studio Systems** * Design and support master control / production control room infrastructure, including production switchers (vision mixers), SDI/IP video routing, and multiviewer systems * Specify and integrate studio and live\-event camera systems (studio and PTZ cameras, camera control units) used for onboard productions — game shows, port talks, sports viewing, and other live programming * Integrate production audio and intercom/talkback systems, distinct from general shipboard PA **Newbuild Project Support** * Support broadcast system design and equipment procurement through the full newbuild construction cycle, from contract design through vessel delivery * Liaise with shipyard trades and subcontractors to ensure correct installation of cabling, headend equipment, and distribution hardware * Participate in factory acceptance testing (FAT) and site acceptance testing (SAT) onboard **Refit \& Retrofit Support** * Plan and execute broadcast system upgrades and replacements during drydock and refit periods, often on compressed timelines * Coordinate system cutovers and integration with legacy shipboard infrastructure **Testing, Commissioning \& Sea Trials** * Commission broadcast and TV distribution systems and verify system performance against design specification * Troubleshoot RF, IP, and satellite signal issues during commissioning and post\-delivery warranty support **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Broadcast Engineering, Telecommunications, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years of broadcast engineering experience — satellite broadcast, IPTV headend, or similar RF/IP video distribution environments * Working knowledge of DVB standards, MPEG encoding/multiplexing, and RF/IP signal distribution * Familiarity with satellite communications systems (VSAT/TVRO) * Ability to read and produce technical/electrical drawings and cable schedules * Experience with production switchers/vision mixers, video routing (SDI and/or IP\-based, e.g., NDI), and multiviewer systems * Strong hands\-on troubleshooting skills in live, time\-constrained environments * Willingness to travel internationally (frequently 10\-25%\+), valid passport or ability to obtain a passport as a condition of employment. * This is a paid position offering competitive compensation. If you are passionate about audio visual technology and possess the required qualifications, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Network Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **About the Role** Control AV, LLC is a design\-build systems integrator serving the cruise industry, delivering broadcast, entertainment, and communications infrastructure for both shipyards and vessel owners across newbuild construction and refit/drydock projects. We are seeking a Network Design Engineer to architect the IP network infrastructure that carries AV, broadcast, and media traffic across our shipboard systems. **This is a design engineering role, not network administration or IT support.** The focus is planning, specifying, designing, and commissioning networks during design and construction — topology, redundancy, capacity, and standards compliance — not day\-to\-day operation of a vessel's IT systems post\-delivery. **Key Responsibilities** **Network Architecture \& Design** * Design IP network topology, VLAN segmentation, and multicast routing (IGMP/PIM) for AV and broadcast traffic, and specify switches, routers, and fiber/copper infrastructure sized for AV\-over\-IP protocols (SMPTE ST 2110, QLAN, Dante, NDI) * Engineer QoS/traffic prioritization and PTP timing/synchronization to support real\-time, low\-latency media flows **Redundancy \& Standards Compliance** * Design resilient, redundant network paths (e.g., SMPTE 2022\-7 style dual\-path protection) for mission\-critical broadcast and production traffic * Design network segmentation and produce topology documentation that clearly demarcates the AV/broadcast network from the vessel's safety\-critical OT systems, supporting the ship's overall IACS UR E26/E27 compliance **Newbuild \& Refit Execution** * Produce network architecture diagrams, IP addressing schemas, and port/cable schedules for shipyard installation teams * Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, and sea trials — verifying multicast flows, latency, and redundancy failover performance **Documentation \& Coordination** * Maintain as\-built network documentation and asset inventories to support class and cybersecurity requirements * Define integration and handoff points with the vessel's core IT/OT network, coordinating with (not operating) the owner's IT infrastructure team **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years designing IP networks specifically for AV, broadcast, or media production environments — not general enterprise IT/network administration * Strong grounding in network fundamentals: VLAN segmentation, multicast routing, QoS/traffic prioritization, redundant topology design * Familiarity with AV\-over\-IP standards and protocols (SMPTE ST 2110, SMPTE 2022\-7, AES67, QLAN, Dante, NDI) * Ability to produce network architecture diagrams, IP addressing schemas, and port/cable schedules * Willingness and ability to travel (10\-25%), including international shipyards * Valid passport or ability to obtain a passport as a condition of employment **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience in cruise (newbuild or refit) or themed entertainment industries. * Familiarity with IACS UR E26/E27 cyber resilience requirements, particularly how they drive network segmentation and boundary documentation between IT/entertainment networks and OT/safety\-critical systems * Vendor certifications relevant to AV/media networking (e.g., SDVoE, Cisco, Arista, Audinate Dante) Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Greater Boston Area, MA **Employment type:** Full\-time **Responsibilities:** * Write embedded software applications in Python and C/C\+\+ that run on our IoT gateways and devices. * Collaborate with team members to develop system architecture for a robust, scalable platform. * Understand user requirements, contribute to the development of product requirements and participate in the entire product development life cycle. * Document your code, APIs and design decisions. * Participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback. **Requirements:** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–3 years of experience building software including internships, co\-ops, research or personal projects. * Programming experience in Python, C/C\+\+ is a plus. * Confident use of the Linux command line, Bash scripting and Git. * Working knowledge of containerization tools such as Docker. * A habit of writing clean, testable code and a willingness to ask questions and learn quickly. * Familiarity with software testing methodologies and design patterns. * Understanding of application design: state machines, event\-driven architecture. **Nice to have:** * Understanding of concurrency on constrained devices: threads or tasks, queues, mutexes and avoiding race conditions. * Exposure to application\-level communication such as TCP/IP, MQTT, BLE/Wi\-Fi or serial command protocols. * Experience with embedded development, including microcontroller platforms such as Arduino or ESP32, and RTOS concepts. * Experience interacting with hardware / low\-level protocols (e.g. I2C, UART, Modbus, CAN) * Debugging on real hardware with JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. * Experience with device fleet management platforms. * Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. **About us:** Today’s research, clinical, and quality control labs are expected to discover and produce at a pace once considered unimaginable. Now, to lead is to be led by data. The Elemental Machines platform elevates LabOps teams in charge of machines, instruments, data, facilities, training, quality, and compliance to lead data\-driven discovery, development, and delivery. But there are over 300 million physical instruments, devices, and machines not yet connected to the cloud.
