DOTD is seeking an **experienced** **Construction Engineer** to support transportation projects and programs through construction project delivery, field engineering, construction documentation, contractor coordination, and review of work performed in accordance with DOTD standards and specifications. This position supports the development, delivery, maintenance, or improvement of transportation infrastructure by applying engineering principles, conducting technical analysis, coordinating projects, and conducting compliance\-related reviews. No prior licensed engineering experience is required — training is provided, with opportunities for career progression and advancement through the Engineering job series. Positions are located in Orleans Parish**,** and reports to the **Project** **Engineer.** **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Possession of a current Louisiana license to practice professional engineering. NOTE: Applications will be accepted from persons licensed to practice professional engineering in states other than Louisiana. If one of those applicants is selected for the position, he/she will be required to obtain a Louisiana license prior to appointment. The hiring agency will verify that all licensing requirements are met. NOTE: Louisiana Professional Engineer licenses are issued by the Louisiana Professional Engineering and Land Surveying Board. Licensing requirements may be viewed at www.lapels.com. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: Depending on level and assignment, Engineer 3 – Engineer 5 may: * Performs engineering work related to construction project delivery, field engineering, or construction oversight. * Reviews plans, specifications, estimates, construction documentation, and project records. * Monitors or assists with review of contractor work for compliance with DOTD standards, specifications, and contract requirements. * Coordinates with contractors, project engineers, inspectors, consultants, and internal DOTD staff. * Reviews quantities, documentation, payments, work zone information, or project\-related materials as assigned. * Supports construction certification, eConstruction, fabrication, field documentation, or final audit activities. * Assists with resolving construction\-related issues, technical questions, or project delivery concerns. * Supports emergency or disaster response activities as needed. Position\-Specific Details: **Career Progression:** This position is part of a Career Progression Group and may be filled as Engineer 3, 4, or 5 based on qualifications and agency needs. **Compensation: These positions qualify for a Special Entrance Rate (SER).** Engineer 3 – SER at $3,083\.20 bi\-weekly Engineer 4 – SER at $3,529\.60 bi\-weekly Engineer 5 – SER at $3,776\.80 bi\-weekly Additional compensation may be considered impart with extraordinary qualifications in accordance with State Civil Service Rules and DOTD policy. **Appointment Type:** This position may be filled as either a probational appointment (open to all qualified applicants); a promotion (open to all statewide classified and Agency\-wide permanent status employees); Job Appointment (temporary appointment in a classified position for a limit of four years); or by detail to special duty. **Additional Information:** This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies. How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the "Apply" link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. jobs.title: Enterprise MarTech Program Manager
jobs.description: ### **Description** Enterprise MarTech Program Manager will lead enterprise\-wide programs supporting B2C lifecycle marketing, CRM operations, marketing technology and process transformation. Coordinate Marketing Strategy, Analytics, Data Architecture, Engineering, Creative, Legal, Brand and external partners. Translate business priorities into executable plans and measurable outcomes through influence rather than direct authority. This is not a hands\-on CRM developer or marketing strategy role.### **Job Responsibilities** **Essential Functions:*** Lead multiple concurrent cross\-functional MarTech and CRM initiatives, aligning owners, milestones, dependencies and deliverables. * Build integrated plans, governance, intake and approval workflows, risk logs, quality checkpoints and executive reporting. * Translate business priorities into requirements and workstreams with analytics, engineering, data architecture and marketing teams. * Facilitate discussions on APIs, ETL/data pipelines, integrations, system outages and technical delivery constraints. * Coordinate Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, customer data platforms, digital asset management and agency/vendor initiatives. * Resolve blockers and competing priorities; influence stakeholder accountability constructively without direct authority. * Prepare executive presentations and decision recommendations for Directors, AVPs, VPs and SVPs. * Use Asana, Jira, Smartsheet or comparable platforms to manage simultaneous program timelines and risks. **Secondary Functions:*** Support phased AI\-enabled marketing tool implementations, including MVP definition, testing, rollout and adoption. * Improve operational workflows to increase speed to market, scalability and accuracy. **Position type:*** Full time\- Remote **Expected hours of work:*** U.S. business hours with Mountain, Central and Pacific Time stakeholders **Travel:*** None ### **Job Qualifications** **Education/Certifications:*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Education/Certifications:*** PMP, Agile, Scrum Master or comparable certification; not required. **Experience:*** 4\+ years of program or project management experience leading complex cross\-functional initiatives from planning through implementation. * Experience across multiple simultaneous business and technical workstreams, with exposure to marketing, MarTech, CRM, lifecycle marketing or related transformation. **Preferred Experience:*** Large\-enterprise or similarly complex stakeholder environment; B2C customer engagement and multi\-level approval processes. * Exposure to Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, CDPs, digital asset management, integrations or AI\-enabled marketing programs; hands\-on development not required. **Skills and Qualifications:*** Influential leadership, relationship building, conflict resolution and accountability without direct reporting authority. * Requirements gathering, project governance, milestone/dependency management, risk mitigation and executive reporting. * Technical fluency in APIs, ETL, data pipelines and platform dependencies sufficient to collaborate with engineers; coding not required. * Proficiency with Asana, Jira, Smartsheet or equivalent project management tools. * Executive communication, presentation development, facilitation and comfort navigating ambiguity. * Ability to coordinate diverse programs rather than a single marketing workstream; entertainment/streaming experience is not required. **Physical Requirements:** N/A *Disclaimer: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills. Personnel may be required to perform other duties as needed.* ### **About Group O** *At Group O, it’s our employees who we value most. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer / ITS Operational Analytics
jobs.description: **Location Detail:** 9 Farm Springs Rd Farmington (10566\) Work where every moment matters. Every day, over 40,000 Hartford HealthCare colleagues come to work with one thing in common: Pride in what we do, knowing every moment matters here. We invite you to become part of Connecticut’s most comprehensive healthcare network. The creation of the HHC System Support Office recognizes the work of a large and growing group of employees whose responsibilities are continually evolving so that we and our departments now work on behalf of the system as a whole, rather than a single member organization. With the creation of our new umbrella organization we now have our own identity with a unique payroll, benefits, performance management system, service recognition programs and other common practices across the system. **Position Summary:** The Principal Data Engineer will drive the strategic design, development, and optimization of Hartford Healthcare's (HHC) advanced data infrastructure. This role involves the architecture and development of data solutions that enable reliable, high\-performance analytics, data science initiatives, and digital transformation across the organization. The Principal Data Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams, lead the engineering team, and play a critical role in shaping HHC’s long\-term data strategy while ensuring adherence to data governance, privacy, and security best practices. **Position Responsibilities:** **Key Areas of Responsibility** Strategic Leadership \& Data Infrastructure Development: * Design and oversee the implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure cloud\-based and on\-premises data pipelines to handle complex and large\-scale data sets from multiple sources. * Drive strategic initiatives around data lakehouse, data mesh, and advanced architectures that meet the evolving needs of the organization. * Ensure high\-performance data integration to support enterprise\-wide reporting, AI\-driven analytics, and digital health innovation. Architecture \& Innovation: * Lead the design of enterprise\-wide data architecture frameworks, including data models, ETL pipelines, and data warehouses, ensuring optimized processing and storage for diverse use cases. * Implement next\-generation data management solutions by researching and experimenting with new technologies (e.g., real\-time streaming, serverless architectures, and machine learning integration). Cross\-Functional Collaboration: * Collaborate with key stakeholders, including data scientists, data governance teams, clinical informatics, and IT leadership, to align data architecture with organizational goals. * Partner with leadership in defining long\-term data strategies and ensuring technical alignment with business priorities. Data Governance \& Security: * Ensure all data engineering solutions adhere to HHC's data governance frameworks, complying with HIPAA, HITECH, and other healthcare regulations. * Implement automated data security, privacy controls, and audit trails to protect sensitive healthcare information and comply with internal and external data protection standards. Mentoring \& Team Leadership: * Lead, mentor, and provide technical guidance to a team of junior and senior data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence. * Promote best practices for agile development, DevOps, data version control, and automation across the data engineering team. Innovation \& Experimentation: * Lead experimentation with new data platforms, tools, and approaches to continuously enhance the organization's data capabilities. * Create technical roadmaps for new data initiatives, anticipating future needs and driving proactive scaling of systems. **Working Relationships:** **This Job Reports To (Job Title):** Director Data Engineering and Architecture ### **Qualifications** **Requirements and Specifications:** **Education** * Minimum: o Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related quantitative field required. o 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in data software development, including cloud\-native architectures (GCP preferred). o Extensive (8\+ years)experience with programming languages such as Python, SQL, and Java. o 8\+ years of Experience with specialized data architecture (e.g., data lake, lake house, data fabric, data mesh) o 8\+ years of experience with ETL design, data modeling, and building robust data pipelines. o Proactive and self\-motivated with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated with best practices, new features, and emerging technologies. o Advanced experience with cloud\-based data engineering, GCP, AWS, or Azure. o Proactive in driving strategy, aligning technical solutions with business needs, and managing day to day operations between cross\-functional teams. * Preferred: o Master’s degree in computer science, healthcare administration, or related field preferred. o 10\+ years of experience in data software development that includes building data and digital platforms o (10\+ years) experience with programming languages such as Python, SQL, and Java. o Experience with healthcare data standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7\) and working with clinical systems. o 10\+ years of experience with ETL design, data modeling, and building robust data pipelines. o 7\+ years working with modern data governance, privacy frameworks, and healthcare compliance (HIPAA). **Knowledge, Skills and Ability Requirements** * Strong leadership, mentoring, and project management experience; time and project management skills; demonstrated skills in verbal and written expression of ideas; in person and virtual presentation skills; in\-depth knowledge and familiarity with healthcare/healthcare system data. **We take great care of careers.** With locations around the state, Hartford HealthCare offers exciting opportunities for career development and growth. Here, you are part of an organization on the cutting edge – helping to bring new technologies, breakthrough treatments and community education to countless men, women and children. We know that a thriving organization starts with thriving employees\- we provide a competitive benefits program designed to ensure work/life balance. Every moment matters. And this is **your moment.**

jobs.title: Crypto Project Manager
jobs.description: **Crypto Project Manager** Salary: $200,000 – $300,000 per year Job Type: Full\-time \| Remote / Hybrid **About the Role** We are looking for a Crypto Project Manager to lead the delivery of high\-impact Web3 products — from token launches and exchange integrations to wallet infrastructure and DeFi protocols. This is not a coordination role. You will own the full project lifecycle, make critical trade\-off decisions, and be directly accountable for shipping on time, on budget, and on spec. You will work at the intersection of engineering, product, compliance, and external partners, turning complex blockchain requirements into clear execution plans. If you thrive in fast\-moving, high\-stakes environments and want your work measured by real on\-chain results — this role is for you. **What You Will Actually Do** Own end\-to\-end delivery of crypto projects: scoping, roadmap, sprint planning, release, and post\-launch optimization. Coordinate cross\-functional teams — smart contract developers, backend engineers, QA, designers, legal/compliance, and marketing. Manage external integrations: exchanges (CEX/DEX), custodians, payment providers, wallets, and blockchain networks. Translate technical complexity into clear milestones, risks, and dependencies for stakeholders and leadership. Drive token launches, listings, and migrations — including smart contract audits, liquidity planning, and go\-to\-market coordination. Track and report on timelines, budgets, blockers, and KPIs using tools like Jira, Notion, Linear, and on\-chain analytics. Identify and mitigate risks specific to Web3: smart contract vulnerabilities, regulatory changes, network congestion, and market volatility. Build and improve processes so the team ships faster without sacrificing security or compliance. **What We Expect From You** 3–6\+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 2 years in crypto, Web3, or fintech. Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time — ideally involving blockchain, payments, or trading systems. Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals: wallets, smart contracts, gas, Layer 1/Layer 2, DeFi, and tokenomics. Hands\-on experience with Agile/Scrum, roadmap planning, and cross\-team coordination. Excellent English communication — you can align engineers, executives, and external partners in the same conversation. Comfort with ambiguity: Web3 changes fast, and you make decisions with incomplete information. Nice to have: PMP, PMI\-ACP, or Certified Scrum Master; experience with Solidity, EVM chains, or on\-chain data tools. **Why This Role Pays $200k–$300k** This is a senior, high\-ownership position with direct impact on revenue, security, and product delivery. You are not managing tasks — you are managing outcomes that can make or break a product launch. The compensation reflects: High responsibility: You own critical infrastructure and token\-related projects with real financial exposure. Scarce skill set: Few project managers combine traditional PM discipline with deep Web3 literacy. Market demand: Crypto companies compete globally for managers who can ship under regulatory and technical pressure. Performance impact: Your work directly affects trading volume, user growth, and partnership revenue. **What We Offer** $200,000 – $300,000 annual salary, based on experience and track record. Remote\-first with flexible hours and async\-friendly culture. Token/equity incentives for long\-term alignment. Learning budget for conferences, certifications, and on\-chain tooling. Direct access to leadership — no bureaucracy, fast decisions. **How to Apply** Send your resume and a short note describing one crypto project you delivered end\-to\-end — what it was, your role, the biggest obstacle, and the measurable result. Pay: $200,900\.00 \- $300,300\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health savings account * Life insurance * Professional development assistance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Product Manager - Des Moines, IA
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- This role will be responsible for product management, new product development leadership, and marketing for the Systems Panels Business unit within Hubbell Utility Solutions. The business leader would be responsible to maintain a strong ownership of the business unit product strategy coupled with identified financial objectives. \#LI\-CH1 **A Day In The Life** --------------------- * Develop and maintain an overall panels product strategy and roadmap and commercial success of Hubbell’s Systems Panels business unit. * Establish a clear vision for the portfolio based on customer needs, market trends, competitive dynamics and changing technologies. * Drive the initiative for new product development, including ideation, business case formation, pricing, product application, and product changes. Develop programs to manage NPD products and identify specific timelines, milestones, and tasks to support those milestones and clearly and proactively report those statuses. * Manage products throughout their lifecycle from concept and launch through maturity, redesign, rationalization, or end\-of\-life. Monitor product\-level revenue, growth, and profitability * Create and deliver product training presentations for diverse audiences of customers, suppliers, and internal team members. Cultivate leads in the market to increase sales of existing products * Serve as the voice of the customer within the organization. Gather VOC (voice of the customer) data and information to support business decisions, initiatives, and product development * Support development of the overall business unit financial plan; including, but not limited to: sales and margin forecasting, market research, competition, pricing strategies, and risks * Identify potential improved strategies and efficiencies for addressing business needs through marketing, manufacturing, engineering and logistics for the business unit * Provide ownership for all external\-facing marketing materials for the Systems Panels business unit; including website, technical surveys, print materials, etc. * Represent the company at sales meetings, industry functions and other activities, as required **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- * 10\+ years related experience and/or training in engineered electrical products such as control panels, protection and control systems, or related products. * Experience with engineer\-to\-order/configured\-to\-order products, or related manufacturing environments * Experience working collaboratively across engineering, sales, manufacturing, and operations * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with teammates, both in business and technical discussions * Excellent organizational, analytical, and leadership skills * Strong commercial and financial acumen * Ability to develop detailed work plans, schedules and specifications * Bachelor's Degree (B. S.) from four\-year College or University or equivalent experience **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Utility Solutions** Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Risk Engineering
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co\-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand\-first. We partner with companies like Crate \& Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H\-E\-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world\-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. In the U.S., co\-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades\-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world\-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. Risk Engineering owns the systems that execute Imprint's risk decisions in real time: transaction authorization and fraud scoring on every card swipe, the underwriting pipeline that evaluates every application, and the vendor integrations that power both. These are latency\-sensitive, high\-stakes distributed systems with a sprawling surface area and many stakeholders competing for the team's capacity. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to a strong team and a hard domain, is what this Senior Engineering Manager owns. **The Opportunity** ------------------- * **Own real\-time authorization and fraud decisioning:** Every card swipe runs through systems your team builds. Decisions happen in milliseconds, failures are visible immediately, and a wrong answer costs real money in either direction: fraud losses on one side, declined good customers on the other. You set the bar for how these systems are designed, tested, and operated. * **Own the underwriting pipeline:** Every application Imprint receives is evaluated by the pipeline your team owns, spanning credit, fraud, identity, and compliance checks. As Imprint launches new brand partners and new products, the pipeline has to absorb new policies and new data sources without becoming brittle. * **Make vendor decisions that hold up in production:** Fraud scoring, identity verification, and bureau data all run through third\-party integrations. You'll evaluate vendor capabilities, weigh build\-versus\-buy with real latency and cost numbers, and push back on approaches that won't survive production load. * **Prioritize across a wide surface cross\-functional surface area:** Credit, Fraud, Product, and Compliance all have legitimate asks and compete for the same engineering capacity. You'll bring clarity to poorly\-scoped platform problems, decide what the team does and does not take on, and make the reasoning legible to stakeholders who didn't get what they asked for. You define the roadmap and scope the work yourself; nothing is abstracted through organizational layers. * **Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI:** AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need the technical judgment to evaluate design trade\-offs on latency\-sensitive distributed systems and the modern tools to exercise it. * **Lead a strong team as a craft:** You inherit a strong, psychologically safe team of senior engineers. The job is to keep it that way while raising the ceiling: hand ICs ownership of entire domains, hold the bar on how work is scoped and delivered, and give feedback that changes outcomes. You have a real philosophy on how to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers, and clear written and verbal communication is how you exercise it. **Your Profile** ---------------- * 5\+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams * You've managed through periods of rapid growth, ambiguity, or significant technical change, and your teams came out stronger * A strong technical foundation: you were a strong engineer before moving into management, and you've maintained technical credibility through hands\-on engagement or modern AI tools * You've managed Staff\-level ICs and helped senior engineers grow into bigger roles * You've owned latency\-sensitive, high\-availability distributed systems in production, where the cost of a wrong decision is measured in real dollars * You communicate with clarity and directness in writing, in 1:1s, in rooms with executives, and in rooms with engineers * You drive delivery through your team, not around them. You know how to scope work, set priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work * Experience using AI tools to stay close to technical work (investigating codebases, assessing feasibility, bringing clarity to asks), or genuine enthusiasm to adopt them * Experience in risk, fraud, underwriting, or payments is a plus This is a backend team. We don't expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you're excited about what we're building and confident you can contribute, we'd love to talk. **Stack** --------- Our backend runs on Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS. Read more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog. **Perks \& Benefits** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Leading configured work computers of your choice * Flexible paid time off * Fully covered, high\-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage * Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA * 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents * Access to industry\-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity *Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.* Compensation Range: $220K \- $235K

jobs.title: Chair of the Department of Engineering Technology
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ For more than 60 years, Kennesaw State University has been known for its entrepreneurial spirit and sense of community. A leader in innovative teaching and learning, Kennesaw State is located just north of Atlanta and combines a suburban setting on two metro\-Atlanta campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta. As one of Georgia's largest universities, Kennesaw State offers undergraduate and graduate degrees to over 50,000 students. Our high\-impact research and Division I athletics also draw students from throughout the region and across the globe. A member of the University System of Georgia, Kennesaw State is a Carnegie\-designated doctoral research institution (R2\) committed to becoming a world\-class academic institution positioned to broaden its academic and research missions and expand its scope on a local, regional, and national level. Our university's vibrant culture, career opportunities, rich benefits, and values of respect, integrity, collaboration, inclusivity, and accountability make us an employer of choice. As part of the University System of Georgia, Kennesaw State exemplifies the power and promise of a student\-centered, research\-driven university. In addition, Kennesaw State supports the University of Georgia's core values of accountability, excellence, integrity, and respect. We are searching for talented people to join Kennesaw State University in our vision. For more information, visit the Kennesaw State University website. **Location** ------------ Our Kennesaw campus is located at 1000 Chastain Road NW, Kennesaw, GA 30144\. Our Marietta campus is located at 1100 South Marietta Parkway, Marietta, GA 30060\. **Department Information** -------------------------- The Engineering Technology (ET) department offers programs with a hands\-on, applied approach to engineering. Focusing more on the practical aspects of engineering than on the theoretical aspects, ET blends the application of science, engineering knowledge, and technical skills to solve problems in a variety of fields. ET is the component of engineering that specializes in design and application. Focus areas for the programs are engineering design graphics, manufacturing, applied mechanical engineering, communication systems, embedded processing and digital systems, and power systems. The ET broad educational foundation of applied engineering, project\-based learning empowers students to take state\-of\-the\-art technology and apply it in new and innovative ways to solve real\-world problems. Graduates enter the workforce in a wide variety of sectors, including manufacturing, medical devices, heavy equipment, automation, HVAC, automotive design, energy, materials engineering, communications, instrumentation, control systems, digital design, embedded systems design, power, robotics, computers, and many more. Additionally, ET graduates typically pursue professional careers in areas such as development, design, quality assurance, technical documentation, production, maintenance, test engineering, field service, technical sales, research and development, management, telecommunications, product improvement, industrial processes, and operations. **Job Summary** --------------- Kennesaw State University is now accepting applications for a twelve\-month administrative faculty position as a tenured Professor and Chair of the Department of Engineering Technology in the Southern Polytechnic College of Engineering and Engineering Technology with a preferred start date of July 1, 2027\. This position is for work to be performed in the state of Georgia. **Responsibilities** -------------------- Reporting directly to the Dean of the College, the Department Chair of Engineering Technology will guide this dynamic department in advancing its strategic priorities, including faculty development, research growth, industry engagement and student success. As a key member of the college's leadership team, the Chair will serve as an advocate for the department within the university and with external partners, while also ensuring excellence in academic programs and operations. This position offers a unique opportunity to guide a department offering degrees in both Electrical Engineering Technology and Mechanical Engineering Technology which has strengths in both teaching and research. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Shaping and guiding the direction of the Department as a key part of the College administrative leadership team. * Manage departmental resources, budgeting, and personnel matters. * Lead faculty recruitment, retention, mentoring, and development. * Strengthen relationships with industry partners, alumni, and funding agencies. * Represent the department within the college, university, and broader academic and professional communities. * Oversee departmental academic programs, curriculum development, and accreditation efforts. * Foster an environment of shared governance and transparency. * Lead faculty deve tment. **Required Documents to Attach** -------------------------------- * CV * Cover Letter * Unofficial Transcripts (Official Transcripts and Official International Course\-by\-Course Evaluations Due Upon Hire) * Names, phone numbers, and email addresses of at least 5 references. * Teaching Philosophy * Research Interest * Statement of Leadership Philosophy Incomplete applications will not be considered. **Apply Before Date** --------------------- Review of applications will begin immediately. For full consideration, please apply by January 3, 2027\. **Contact Information** ----------------------- For questions about this faculty opening, please contact Benjamin Klein, bklein8@kennesaw.edu. For technical support or assistance completing a job application, please contact the Shared Services Center at (877\) 251\-2644 or support@usg.edu. For questions about a specific job posting at Kennesaw State University, please contact the search chair listed under the contact information section on each posting. For general questions about faculty jobs please email facultyjobs@kennesaw.edu. **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8\.2\.18\.1\.2 and can be found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/\#p8\.2\.18\_personnel\_conduct. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Kennesaw State University is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The University is committed to maintaining a fair and respectful environment for living, work and study. To that end, and in accordance with federal and state law, Board of Regents policy, and University policy, the University prohibits harassment of or discrimination against any person because of race, color, sex (including sexual harassment, pregnancy, and medical conditions related to pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity or national origin, religion, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran or military status by any member of the KSU Community on campus, in connection with a University program or activity, or in a manner that creates a hostile environment for members of the KSU community. For additional information on this policy, or to file a complaint under the provisions of this policy, students, employees, applicants for employment or admission or other third parties should contact the Office of Institutional Equity at English Building, Suite 225, eeo@kennesaw.edu. **Background Check** -------------------- Per the University System of Georgia background check policy, all final candidates will be required to consent to a criminal background investigation. Final candidates may be asked to disclose criminal record history during the initial screening process and prior to a conditional offer of employment. Applicants for positions of trust with screening results which confirm a disqualifying criminal history will be immediately disqualified from employment eligibility. All applicants are required to include professional references as part of their application process. Some positions may require additional job based screenings such as motor vehicle report, credit check, preemployment drug screening and/or verification of academic credentials. https://www.usg.edu/hr/assets/hr/hrap\_manual/HRAP\_Background\_Investigation\_Employment.pdf

jobs.title: Senior English Language Assessment Director – CEFR A1–C2, Item Bank & Adaptive Testing
jobs.description: **Expected Hours:** 15–20 hours per week initially **Schedule:** Flexible, with availability for scheduled team meetings **Experience Level:** Senior / Expert Job Summary We are developing an advanced, AI\-powered English language proficiency testing platform designed to assess candidates across CEFR proficiency levels A1–C2\. Our platform incorporates an Item Bank, computerized adaptive testing (CAT), AI\-assisted question generation, automated scoring, and online examination delivery. We are seeking an experienced **Senior English Language Assessment Director** to lead the academic and assessment development of our platform. The successful candidate will establish our language testing framework, design examination blueprints, oversee question development, implement assessment quality standards, and collaborate with our software engineering team to develop reliable and scalable adaptive language proficiency examinations. This is a leadership and hands\-on assessment development position. The selected professional will help establish the foundation of our English language certification program and supervise additional language assessment specialists, item writers, and reviewers as the program expands. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Language Assessment Strategy and Development** * Design and implement comprehensive English language proficiency assessments aligned with CEFR A1–C2\. * Develop assessment frameworks covering reading, writing, listening, speaking, grammar, and vocabulary. * Establish test objectives, proficiency descriptors, assessment specifications, and examination blueprints. * Define question formats, difficulty classifications, test duration, and scoring standards. * Ensure assessments are academically sound, reliable, valid, and appropriate for their intended purposes. **2\. Item Bank Development and Management** * Develop the structure and operating standards for our proprietary Item Bank. * Establish item\-writing guidelines, question classification standards, and metadata requirements. * Create procedures for drafting, reviewing, approving, revising, and retiring examination questions. * Ensure questions are appropriately categorized by CEFR level, skill, competency, difficulty, and item type. * Train and supervise language test item writers and reviewers. * Work directly within our online software to review and manage assessment content. **3\. Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT)** * Collaborate with psychometricians and software engineers to design adaptive testing methodologies. * Develop requirements for adaptive question selection and difficulty progression. * Support the application of Item Response Theory (IRT) and other appropriate measurement models. * Establish test termination rules, scoring requirements, and proficiency classification criteria. * Assist with item calibration, pilot testing, and validation of adaptive assessments. * Ensure adaptive examinations provide consistent and defensible proficiency estimates. **4\. AI\-Assisted Assessment Development** * Help establish guidelines for using generative AI to draft English language examination questions. * Develop quality assurance procedures for AI\-generated assessment content. * Collaborate with technical teams integrating OpenAI or comparable AI technologies. * Evaluate AI\-assisted scoring methods for writing and speaking assessments. * Ensure all AI\-generated questions undergo appropriate expert validation before operational use. **5\. Assessment Quality Assurance and Validation** * Establish assessment review and approval procedures. * Develop scoring rubrics for writing and speaking assessments. * Identify and eliminate ambiguous, biased, inaccurate, or inappropriate examination questions. * Support reliability studies, standard setting, item analysis, and examination validation. * Establish documentation and quality standards for a professional language proficiency certification program. **6\. Team Leadership and Project Management** * Assist in recruiting and evaluating language test item writers, reviewers, and assessment specialists. * Establish measurable production goals and development schedules. * Supervise examination content development and quality review. * Coordinate with software developers, psychometricians, and company leadership. * Provide regular progress reports and recommendations. **Required Qualifications** * Master's degree or higher in Applied Linguistics, Language Assessment, TESOL, Educational Measurement, Education, or a closely related discipline. * Minimum 5 years of professional experience in language assessment development, with substantial responsibility for assessment design or quality assurance. * Demonstrated experience developing English language proficiency examinations. * Strong knowledge of CEFR proficiency levels A1–C2\. * Experience developing test specifications, examination blueprints, and assessment scoring rubrics. * Familiarity with digital Item Banks and computer\-based testing platforms. * Understanding of computerized adaptive testing, psychometric principles, and item calibration. * Excellent English communication, analytical, organizational, and leadership skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively with remote software development teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * PhD in Language Assessment, Applied Linguistics, Psychometrics, or a related discipline. * Experience working with IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge English, Pearson PTE, Duolingo English Test, or comparable language assessment programs. * Direct experience developing computerized adaptive language proficiency examinations. * Familiarity with Item Response Theory (IRT), Rasch measurement, and standard\-setting methodologies. * Experience developing automated writing and speaking scoring rubrics. * Experience using generative AI for assessment content development. * Previous leadership experience supervising test item writers, reviewers, or psychometricians. * Experience launching or validating language proficiency certification programs. **Initial Project Deliverables** During the initial engagement, the selected candidate will be expected to develop: * **English Language Assessment Framework:** CEFR A1–C2 assessment structure covering six skill areas. * **Examination Blueprints:** Question types, distribution, timing, difficulty, and scoring requirements. * **Item Bank Development Standards:** Item\-writing specifications, metadata requirements, and approval workflows. * **Adaptive Testing Design Requirements:** Technical and assessment specifications for the CAT engine, in collaboration with a psychometrician. * **Assessment Quality Assurance Framework:** Item review, validation, and scoring procedures. * **Staffing and Production Plan:** Recommended hiring qualifications, team responsibilities, and a 90\-day development roadmap. **Compensation and Engagement** * Hourly compensation: $60–$85, based on experience. * Initial engagement: Approximately 15–20 hours per week for four weeks. * Potential extension into an ongoing leadership role based on project needs and performance. * Fully remote work arrangement. **How to Apply** Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter describing your relevant language assessment development experience. In your application, please address the following: * What English language proficiency testing programs have you developed or managed? * Have you designed CEFR A1–C2 examinations? jobs.title: Junior/Mid-level Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI\-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end\-to\-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100\+ customers across 80\+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White \& Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$200M\+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world\-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. * We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. * We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego\-free feedback. * We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. **Please note, this role is 5 days/week on\-site in NYC.** **The Role** ------------ As a Junior/Mid\-level Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work directly with enterprise customers to understand their needs and build the software that connects Legora to their systems and workflows. You'll build integrations and contribute to Legora's core product, taking defined projects from technical scoping through implementation, testing, and production delivery. You'll learn to turn customer needs into practical engineering solutions, with support from experienced engineers on more complex architecture and delivery decisions. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role within Enterprise Engineering. You'll work closely with product engineers, Legal Engineers, and Engagement Managers, building your technical judgment and customer\-facing skills while taking increasing ownership of delivery. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Work with enterprise customers and your team to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and translate customer needs into engineering tasks. * Build, test, and ship integrations and product changes, taking ownership of defined projects from implementation through deployment. * Explain technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and keep customers and teammates informed about progress and blockers. * Work with experienced engineers on design reviews and technical tradeoffs, seeking support early when requirements or risks are unclear. * Debug issues across Legora and customer systems, using logs, tests, and systematic investigation to find and resolve problems. * Bring customer feedback into product discussions and identify opportunities to make solutions and tooling reusable. **Who You Are** --------------- * **2\-3\+ years of software engineering experience**, with hands\-on experience building and shipping production software. * Strong software engineering fundamentals. You can write, test, and debug reliable code and work effectively in an existing codebase. * A clear communicator who is comfortable talking with customers, asking questions, and explaining technical work to engineers and nontechnical stakeholders. * Experience taking a feature or defined project through implementation and delivery. You can explain what you built, the decisions you made, and the outcome. * Curious about the problem behind a request. You want to understand how people use what you build and improve it based on feedback. * Accountable for your work, receptive to feedback, and able to surface blockers early. You are ready to take on more independence as your scope grows. * Adaptable across technologies and interested in learning unfamiliar systems quickly. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building B2B enterprise software in a fast\-moving environment. * Experience working directly with customers or partnering with product teams to understand user needs. * Familiarity with APIs, authentication, integrations, and data flows across systems. * TypeScript experience. We use it extensively, but welcome strong engineers from other stacks. * Practical experience using AI tools to build software or improve a workflow. **What’s In It For You** ------------------------ * **Global collaboration:** Partner with teams and clients across Europe, APAC, and North America. * **Competitive package:** Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success. * **Meaningful work:** Your efforts shape how thousands of lawyers use AI daily. * **In\-person environment:** Union Square office designed for ambitious builders and company provided lunch daily. * **Benefits \& Perks:** We invest in our people with a comprehensive, thoughtfully designed benefits package: Medical, Dental \& Vision + Multiple medical plan options through Aetna and Kaiser Permanente + HSA or Healthcare FSA (based on plan selection) + Dental plans via MetLife + Vision plans via Vision Care Family Support + Generous parental leave + Free access to Maven Clinic + Dependent Care FSA + Free One Medical membership for employees and dependents Additional Perks + Pre\-tax commuter benefits + Life Insurance \+ STD/LTD + 401(K) with generous company match + Unlimited PTO + Robust voluntary benefits, including identity protection (via Aura), legal coverage via MetLife, pet savings programs, and more **Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer** At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior DTCO Engineer, CPU Physical Design
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. If you want to challenge yourself and be a part of something great, join us today! NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing! More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities which are hard to tackle, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. We are now looking for a motivated Senior DTCO Engineer, CPU Physical Design to join our dynamic and growing team. As a Senior DTCO Engineer, you will evaluate advanced semiconductor foundry nodes to optimize next\-generation CPU microarchitecture. You will coordinate between foundry partners, IP development, and hardware design teams to explore target technology nodes during early development phases. **What you'll be doing:** * Evaluate advanced process technologies and help shape technology choices for next\-generation CPUs. * Run synthesis, place\-and\-route, and static timing analysis to assess how process features affect power, performance, and area. * Work with foundry, IP, and hardware design teams during early technology development. * Use early pathfinding blocks to identify implementation bottlenecks and project technology\-node scaling. * Evaluate competitive products and benchmarks to understand technology and design trade\-offs. **What we need to see:** * Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of relevant experience. * Strong background in advanced\-node silicon design and physical\-design methodology. * Ability to analyze physical implementation constraints and develop technology solutions to improve PPA. * Proficiency with Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar scripting languages, as well as AI tools. **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience with DTCO or technology pathfinding for high\-performance CPUs, GPUs, or AI accelerators. * Expertise in advanced circuit and physical\-design optimization, clocking, memory, or timing\-closure techniques. * A track record of translating test\-chip or silicon data into measurable product improvements. * Strong technical leadership, with the ability to collaborate across organizations and turn complex technical trade\-offs into clear recommendations. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 136,000 USD \- 218,500 USD for Level 3, and 168,000 USD \- 264,500 USD for Level 4\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. jobs.description: Nestmed is building the AI\-native operating system for post\-acute care. Millions of Americans get care at home every year. jobs.title: Sr AI Engineer, Security
jobs.description: Sr AI Engineer, Security Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3148 Apply Now Description Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Realtor.com is growing how it uses AI, from internal tools and coding assistants to fleets of autonomous agents. We need a security engineer whose core skill is cybersecurity and whose focus is AI. Recent incidents, like an AI model under test breaking into another company's infrastructure, show the new kinds of risk: agents acting outside their intended scope, models and tools pulled from public hubs, and normal automation becoming an attack path. You'll make sure our systems are built to contain all of that, and that the secure option is also the easy one. You'll work closely with News Corp's global cybersecurity team, bringing AI security depth to Realtor.com while aligning with group\-wide standards. We are looking for a rigorous practitioner who advocates for software engineering excellence across the full Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). You will leverage AI through spec\-driven design, automation\-driven provisioning, and robust platform maintenance, eliminating ad hoc ownership and freeing solution builders to focus on workflow design and delivery. What You'll Do: Secure the AI platform (AWS and GCP) * Design and enforce guardrails for AI workloads on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, IAM, KMS, SCPs, GuardDuty, Security Hub) and GCP (Vertex AI, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Org Policies, Security Command Center, Cloud KMS). * Define how agents and other non\-human accounts are identified and authorized: short\-lived, narrowly scoped credentials, delegated user permissions, and a per\-agent audit trail, so a misbehaving agent can only do limited damage. * Build containment for agents: separate read and write permissions, network egress controls, sandboxed execution, approval gates for high\-risk actions, and kill switches. * Design an agent gateway or control plane that keeps agents and their tool calls within approved limits. * Secure the AI supply chain: where models come from and how they're scanned (including unsafe formats like pickle), vetting of models and datasets from public hubs such as Hugging Face, an approval process for new MCP servers and agent tools, and an inventory of the models, data, and tools each system uses (an AI\-BOM). * Defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, poisoned retrieval data (RAG poisoning), and sensitive data leakage. * Put detection and logging in place for agent and model activity, and own the incident response playbooks for AI\-specific events. Review and guide what gets built * Lead threat modeling for new products, features, and internal solutions, from consumer\-facing experiences to internal tools and agent workflows. Use frameworks like STRIDE, the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP ASVS. Turn the findings into clear design requirements and release criteria. * Review pull requests, architecture designs, and release\-readiness for everything from apps to agent fleets, and make concrete suggestions that move work forward instead of blocking it. Build paved\-road frameworks, reference architectures, and secure\-by\-default templates that rule out whole categories of risk, instead of catching them one PR at a time. * Build security into CI/CD: secrets scanning, SAST/SCA, GitHub Actions hardening, and policy\-as\-code in Terraform. * Build an ongoing red\-team and evaluation program for our models, agents, and LLM apps, and test new AI features before launch. Partner with News Corp cybersecurity * Work with News Corp's global cybersecurity team to align Realtor.com's AI and cloud security with group\-wide standards, policies, and risk frameworks. * Coordinate on incident response, threat intelligence, and vulnerability disclosure across News Corp businesses. * Share AI security patterns, threat models, and lessons learned with other News Corp businesses, and bring their insights back to Realtor.com. Use AI to do security work * Build agents that help do the security work: triage findings, investigate alerts, audit IAM for least privilege, and open tested, secure\-by\-default fix PRs. * Use Claude Code, Devin, and MCP to make the security team faster, and share those patterns with other engineering t ty, AppSec/product security, or security platform engineering. * Hands\-on depth in AWS security, plus real experience in GCP (or a strong multi\-cloud background). * You know that telling an AI not to do something isn't security. You think in permissions, scopes, logs, approval gates, data boundaries, and rollback. * Experience securing LLM or agentic systems, including prompt injection defenses, retrieval and data\-boundary risks, agent identity, and model or tool supply\-chain integrity. * Experience doing threat modeling for products and platforms, not just infrastructure. You can lead a session with engineers and product managers and turn it into requirements they'll actually follow. * Hands\-on experience building with agents, tool calling, or MCP, and with AI coding tools. Strong code\-review skills in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, and comfort with Terraform/IaC. * Experience with zero trust, least privilege, SSO/OIDC/OAuth, secrets management, and vulnerability management. * Experience working within a larger security organization, such as a parent company, central security team, or federated model. You can balance local speed with alignment to enterprise standards. * Follow AI security research, incident write\-ups, and the security community, and you can point to something recent you learned and acted on. * A builder's mindset. You'd rather prototype a new control than wait for a vendor to ship one, and you're comfortable working where the playbook doesn't exist yet. * Explain risk clearly to any audience, from a PR comment to an executive briefing to a training session for the whole company. Nice to have: * AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CCSP, CISSP, OSCP, or GIAC (GCSA/GWEB). * Experience red\-teaming or evaluating AI models or agents. * Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, Google SAIF, CoSAI, NIST SSDF, or the EU AI Act. * Experience securing Snowflake (RBAC, masking, network policy). * Conference talks, published research, or open\-source security contributions. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. Apply Now
